dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus dapgeo 02 initial borehole dataset

description: TU Delft and collaborating organisations publish the initial dataset for DAPGEO-02, a research borehole in the campus geothermal seismic-monitoring network. The provider describes drilling to 499 metres between February and May 2022, adjacent monitoring boreholes, geophones and optical fibres. The resource includes drilling records, core and cuttings inventories, and raw wireline measurements. Core CT images are published separately. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft monitoring site in the Netherlands. The custom time field spans 1 February to 31 May 2022; measurement intervals are not reported. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: CSV, well-log, report and image formats are stated in metadata. Inventories and measurements share one initial-release identity; separate CT images retain their own identity. Simulation uses include geothermal monitoring geometry and subsurface calibration. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
